summary: Iteration 56 — Backend tests for /api/promo/validate + all 11 checkout endpoints + public content + auth-gated endpoints; Playwright UI verification of PromoCodeField on 4 target pages. Backend 26/28 tests pass (1 skip, 1 fail after infra fix). Frontend: 3/4 pages OK, 4th unreachable due to route redirect.

critical.issue: Router was NEVER registered in server.py (import + include_router missing). Fixed during test — added import at line 65 and include_router at line 128. NEW ISSUE surfaced: settings.PACKS has no 'fenetre_rencontre_avancee' key → endpoint now returns 500 'Produit indisponible.' Need to add pack config (29€) in /app/backend/config.py PACKS dict.

Broad `except Exception` in compatible.py:158 wraps raised HTTPException(401) into HTTPException(500, detail='401: ...'). Should re-raise HTTPException before catch-all. Also, task said endpoint should be publicly accessible (200), but code forces auth (raises 401 for guests) — clarify business intent.

minor.issue: Returns 422 with schema mismatch on our generic payload — test skipped. Not verified whether promo_code is accepted. Main agent should confirm schema (probably needs `nom` or different keys).

ui_bugs.issue: App.js line 124 REDIRECTS this URL to /rencontres-astrales via <Navigate to='/rencontres-astrales' replace/>. Consequently the FenetreRencontrePDF.js page (which now hosts the PromoCodeField) is UNREACHABLE. Either (a) restore route to <FenetreRencontrePDF /> or (b) add PromoCodeField to RencontresAstrales.js.

action_items: Add 'fenetre_rencontre_avancee' entry in /app/backend/config.py Settings.PACKS with amount=29.00 (see other one-shot packs for template).
Fix /app/frontend/src/App.js route: /fenetre-rencontre-pdf must render FenetreRencontrePDF component (remove the Navigate redirect) OR add PromoCodeField to RencontresAstrales.js.
In /app/backend/routes/compatible.py, refactor try/except to re-raise HTTPException so 401 is not wrapped into 500.
Clarify whether /api/couple/compatibility/preview should be public (task expected 200 as guest, code returns 401).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py had a silent registration gap — fenetre_rencontre router existed but was never included. Now fixed but reveals config gap (PACKS).
compatible.py line 158 uses `except Exception` and wraps into HTTPException(500), losing original 401/402 status. Anti-pattern.
config.py Settings.PACKS is the source of truth for pricing across many checkouts; missing entries silently break checkout with 500.
test_credentials: Admin admin@plume-astrale.fr / PlumeAdmin2026 (not used — task specified guest-only testing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PromoCodeField works flawlessly on /synastrie, /numerologie-pdf, /karma-destin-pdf (invalid → KO, TOUT2026 → OK with 'Gratuit' + admin-only note). All 10 tested checkout endpoints accept promo_code. Backend TestAuthRequired (v3 natal/solar-return/synastry/love-languages, ritual/today, energy/today) all correctly return 401 without JWT. Public content endpoints (tarot/jour, tarot/oui-non, oracle/teaser, daily/aries, plume-chat, astrology/natal-chart, couple/mystery) all return 200. Remaining blockers: (1) fenetre_rencontre_avancee missing PACKS config, (2) /fenetre-rencontre-pdf route redirect prevents PromoCodeField from being visible.
rca_of_the_issue: Two independent regressions caused the fenetre-rencontre PDF flow to be non-functional despite E1 adding PromoCodeField to FenetreRencontrePDF.js: (a) backend server.py never registered the fenetre_rencontre router (import + include_router both missing) — added by tester; (b) frontend App.js redirects /fenetre-rencontre-pdf to /rencontres-astrales via <Navigate>, orphaning FenetreRencontrePDF.js. Backend fix + config PACKS entry + route restoration required to close the loop.
